results.title: Local soccer prodigy: 16-year-old Hudson native Logan Azar called up to U.S. U-17 National Team
results.description: Earlier last week, the Hudson teenager was named the 2025-26 New England Revolution Academy Player of the Year. He became the 12th recipient of the honor, which the Revolution Technical Staff awards annually to the most exceptional amateur talent developing in the club's Professional Player Pathway.

results.title: Virat Kohli Gifts Indian Jersey To Matt Henry After New Zealand Pacer Destroys India's Batting Line-Up | VIDEO
results.description: Virat Kohli won hearts with a heartwarming gesture towards New Zealand pacer Matt Henry after India's defeat. Following Henry's career-best figures of 6/27, which helped bowl India out for just 89 while chasing 334, Kohli gifted him an Indian team jersey. The moment, shared by the Blackcaps on Instagram, highlighted the spirit of sportsmanship and mutual respect.
